title: FairnessIndex
description: Computed fairness index quantifying measurement symmetry between two benchmark targets.

error_symmetry.description: Symmetry score for error rates between the two targets. 1.0 = both below 0.5% error; 0.0 = either above 1.0% error. Weight: 0.3.

latency_symmetry.description: Symmetry score across latency percentile pairs (p50/p75/p90/p95/p99). 1.0 = max normalized diff < 10%; 0.0 = max normalized diff > 50%. Weight: 0.4.

throughput_confidence.description: Confidence score derived from the throughput ratio (min/max). 1.0 = ratio > 0.9; 0.5 = ratio < 0.7. Weight: 0.2.

db_config_symmetry.description: Fairness score for the DATABASE CONFIGURATION axis — a run INPUT, unlike the three outcome-derived scores above. 1.0 only when both arms saw an identical DB environment AND the fairness-relevant pgjdbc parameters (preferQueryMode, prepareThreshold, defaultRowFetchSize, adaptiveFetch) are all present. NOT a weighted component: it is a hard precondition, because input fairness cannot be traded against good outcome symmetry.

db_config.description: Evidence for the db_config_symmetry score: the per-arm DB-config fingerprint the harness passed down, and the resulting status.

status.description: ok = symmetric and fully normalized. asymmetric = the arms saw different DB config. incomplete_normalization = the arms agreed but the fairness-relevant pgjdbc params are absent (both arms equal, equally wrong — the mode that a naive A==B equality check silently passes). unverified = no fingerprint supplied. Any value other than 'ok' forces composite_score to 0.0 and interpretation to 'unsuitable'.

composite_score.description: Weighted composite fairness score: 0.3*error_symmetry + 0.4*latency_symmetry + 0.2*throughput_confidence, whose weights sum to 0.9 (0.1 remains reserved for a future metadata_symmetry metric). Forced to 0.0 when db_config.status is not 'ok'. NOTE: the emitted value is the raw weighted sum on the 0.0-0.9 scale and is NOT divided by 0.9; the interpretation thresholds are applied to that raw value. The scale is left unchanged so previously published indices stay directly comparable.

interpretation.description: Human-readable interpretation of composite_score: highly_fair >= 0.85, fairly_comparable >= 0.70, moderate_asymmetry >= 0.50, unsuitable < 0.50.

computed_at.description: UTC timestamp when this index was computed.

targets.description: Exactly two target_id strings identifying the compared targets.

asymmetry_notes.description: Optional human-readable notes about detected or declared asymmetries.

dbConfigFingerprint.description: Fingerprint of the EXERIS_DB_* environment the harness passed down to an arm. Secrets are excluded from both the document and the digest.

jdbc_base_url.description: JDBC URL with the query string stripped (parameters are reported separately).

fairness_params.description: The fairness-relevant pgjdbc parameters actually present on the JDBC URL.

fairness_params_missing.description: Fairness-relevant pgjdbc parameters that were ABSENT. Non-empty means the URL was not normalized.

fairness_params_complete.description: True only when every fairness-relevant pgjdbc parameter is present.

env_digest.description: sha256 digest of the sorted, secret-stripped EXERIS_DB_* environment slice.
